## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the smallest possible solution in your own words.

## Verification

- [ ] `composer test`
- [ ] `composer format:check`
- [ ] `composer analyse`
- [ ] Authorization, isolation and transaction behavior reviewed
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated

## Compatibility / risks

Which Laravel versions and broadcast drivers were tested? Document tradeoffs and breaking behavior.

> AI tools may assist, but contributors must review and understand their contributions. Do not submit generated PR descriptions to the Laravel framework repository; comply with upstream rules.
